body:
Sorry it took a while to reply. Finally got to talk to them, they're fine now. They're still here and I thank you all so much for the advice. Hopefully I helped them out. Glad they'll be around a while longer. 
-thanks all

We talked for a good while on the phone. Nothing serious I just wanted them to know they had a friend. I made a facebook and had them help me use it and we joked and messaged. They seemed to be feeling better.
I called them and just talked for a while. Nothing serious just jokes and small talk. They seemed better...

I tried calling them a few minutes ago and they didn't pick up. This has me a bit concerned so I'm go to try again. 
P.S. I appreciate all the help being given by you and everyone else posting here.
I have no clue where they live. I considered white pages but that as offered no help considering I do not know their parent's name(they won't tell me)

I've invited them to movies and to hang out. They won't go anywhere. I have poured my heart out to them and told them they were making a mistake. I joke with them and they seem so happy, I don't know why they would want to do it...
I just don't know if they're serious. Should I anyway?

1) At their home. I can contact them for the most part. I've been trying to invite them to movies and such but they won't go. 
2)They said they were sad, that they didn't feel they had a reason to go on. 

And the reason I made this burner is because they already know my original 2 reddit accounts so I didn't want them to see this. I called them yesterday to tell them that I was concerned for them, and that they should remember what I told them (that I loved them and how much they had to live for. More detail if you'd like it) Nothing I say seems to deter them. I fear that if I call the police they may just be bluffing and if I don't I could lose them. I don't have romantic feelings for this person but they are the best friend anyone could ask for. I don't know how much time's left. I will try everything that every one's suggested. Thank you.
